caption:
Work pressure can keep you alert at night. After a poor night’s sleep, the same demands can feel harder to manage.

In counselling, we look at how your body, mind and daily life affect one another.

Ivana Budišin, clinical psychologist in Luxembourg. Counselling in English and French.
